column16: string
Great tacticians learn that consistency often trumps potential.
The Titans did not vanish from this world. Their might lives on - in you.
Stand your ground, child, keep your senses.\r\nThe pain is fleeting, but victory is forever.
\"In my dreams I see a great warrior, his skin scorched black, his fists aflame.\"
Lay open your veins, and draw power from your own spilled life.
Tear my flesh and splinter my bones. You will never break my spirit.
A wooden construct, mute and blind.\r\nBut fear the wrath of shackled mind.
Embrace the pain, drink it in.\r\nYour enemies will know your agony tenfold.
Give up everything in pursuit of greatness - even life itself.
What need have I for defence when my enemies\r\nare reduced to ash and splinters?
While the mind endures, so too will the body.
Your grandchildren will awaken screaming in memory of what I utter today.
I give you everything, my pets. Do not disappoint me.
To me, brave companions! Feel my radiance flow through you!
I will wear your ghost, and you will die twice: against me, and for me.
The notes may change, but the song remains the same.
Burn the spirit to vitalise the flesh.
Light and unadorned, like wind on water, you will be.
You circle the black scorpion with enmity, daring it time and again.
Skip a beat, hold your breath. Too slow a poison, only death.
The fewer there are, the less you have to share.
My ancestral pact was sealed. Forevermore, I would gain sustenance\r\nonly from the ravaged flesh of my enemies.
Why should I dodge blows that I do not fear?
Utter trust in your defence unleashes ultimate potential.
Balance is good in all things, but especially in the realm of magic.
In battle, certainty is worth a little pain.
We seek to cleanse Corruption, not intensify it, but there may be merit to a paradoxical strategy.
Overcharge the machine at your own risk.
Corruption is change.
